content.text:
`diffJson` no longer throws when an object has a truthy, non-callable `toJSON` property. The full suite passes: 302 tests, 0 failing.

**Cause:** `src/diff/json.ts:100` tested `if (obj && obj.toJSON)` and then called `obj.toJSON()`. So any truthy `toJSON` value was invoked, including the string `"old"` in the report. `JSON.stringify` only calls `toJSON` when it is a function.

**Fix:** The check is now `if (obj && typeof obj.toJSON === 'function')`, so the call only happens for callable values. Objects that really do define `toJSON` (such as `Date`) behave as before.

**Test:** I added a case to `test/diff/json.js` that diffs `{"toJSON":"old"}` against `{"toJSON":"new"}`. It expects a normal line-by-line diff of the `toJSON` property.

I rebuilt `libesm/` with the tsc command you gave before running mocha. The `libesm/` output is regenerated, so it will show up in `git status` if it is tracked.
